rules.source_quote: who owns cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT
All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
Former and present holders of constitutional posts
rules.note: Includes former/present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations and Chairpersons of District Panchayats.

rules.source_quote: All serving or retired officers and employees of Central / State Government
rules.note: Excludes Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees; also covers PSEs and regular local-body employees.

rules.source_quote: All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs.10,000/- or more
rules.note: Excludes Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D pensioners.

rules.source_quote: Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices.
rules.note: Only those registered with a professional body and practising.

rules.source_quote: In case of new beneficiaries being uploaded on the PM-KISAN Portal, all land holding farmers’ families who are Non-resident Indians (NRIs) in terms of the provisions of the Income Tax Act, 1961 shall be excluded from any benefit under the Scheme.
rules.note: Passage applies this to new beneficiaries uploaded on the portal.

rules.source_quote: The cut-off date for determination of eligibility of beneficiaries under the scheme shall be 01.02.2019
rules.note: Exception for transfer by succession on death (ELIGIBILITY-03/04); needs a person to decide how to model it.

rules.source_quote: whose names are entered into the land records
rules.note: Exception for North-East States and Jharkhand.
